title: The Drovers' Sheep

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: The drovers have brought a flock down the farm road, all the way from the hills! They'll rest here tonight.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Will you count them into the pens? Five in each pen, so we know how many came.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Put five sheep in each pen. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a pen with an empty dip, and put a sheep there.

older.prompt: Five sheep in each of five pens. No dips this time: count in fives. How many sheep came?

feedback.full: That pen has five. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four pens of five: twenty sheep, all safe for the night!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Twenty tired sheep, and twenty tired drovers' feet! They'll go on to Bellhaven in the morning.

journal_line: I counted the drovers' sheep into pens of five at the farm.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Five pens of five: twenty-five sheep! Counting in fives is quick, isn't it?
